claims.statement: Tom Allen said he had been chosen referee for the wrestling match between Thiebaud Bauer and Julius Schroeder at the Temple.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allenthen stated that he had been chosen referee, and would fill the position to the best of his ability

claims.statement: Tom Allen came on stage with the lightweight champions Arthur Chambers and Billy Edwards and introduced them to the audience.
claims.excerpt: accompanied by Arthur Chambers and Billy Edwards, the light-weight champions, whom he introduced

notes: Allen only refereed and introduced the lightweight champions; no bout of his own is described.
